subject: Lighthouse: access artifact transfer (SSO & SCIM handoff)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@lighthousehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Lighthouse access artifact transfer (SSO & SCIM)

Hi Sam / Lighthouse procurement team,

Following our SOC 2 intake call last week, Lighthouse asked for a tidy handoff of the IAM artifacts we need to complete authorization evidence collection. To keep the review scoped and quick, can you provide the following by EOD next Wednesday (2027-11-30)?

- SAML assertion samples (at least 10 examples across interactive login and service-to-service flows; include timestamp headers)
- SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days (CSV or NDJSON) showing create/update/delete events
- Role/RBAC snapshot: current role-to-permission mapping export (CSV) and a short owner roster for each high-privilege role
- Redaction guidance for any PII in the exports (if you need us to accept a redacted bundle rather than originals)

We prefer the artifacts uploaded to the shared Drive folder (link below); if you need to send via a secure transfer, let us know and we'll provide an intake mailbox. We also need a PO reference for our records (procurement).

Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/lighthouse-iam-artifacts

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Technical Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks — we can provide the SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta, but two quick asks from our side:
1) Procurement needs a short PO before we transmit the full SCIM export (we can attach a redacted sample in the meantime).
2) We need confirmation on acceptable redaction for user emails and device IDs (we can hash identifiers and include a key-map under NDA).

I copied procurement — procurement@lighthousehealth.com — they'll attach the PO. I'll prep a redaction guidance doc and a zipped samples file early next week.

Sam
